subject: Re: Demo request — production walkthrough (security attestation outstanding)
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@emeraldcare.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: EmeraldCare Procurement <procurement@emeraldcare.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production walkthrough request — Redwood Inference

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick response on the RFP. We're excited to evaluate Redwood for inference at EmeraldCare. We'd like to schedule a production walkthrough / demo that focuses on private deployments and SSO support.

Before we can move forward with a live demo, our procurement & security teams require that vendors complete our portal intake and submit a short security attestation. I've attached the vendor portal instructions to this email. Key items our security team will need before approving an exec demo:
- Completed vendor portal intake (link below)
- Signed NDA (we can share ours or sign yours)
- SSO/IdP metadata or a test account for verification
- High-level SOC2 or equivalent attestation / security questionnaire responses

If you can start the intake today we can typically review in ~3 business days. Proposed demo window from our side: June 12–14 (afternoons PT). If the portal isn't completed, we won't be able to host the production-facing demo.

Link & attachment: Vendor portal instructions (EmeraldCare_Vendor_Portal_Instructions.pdf)
Vendor portal: https://vendor-portal.emeraldcare.com/intake/abcd-1234

Appreciate it — I'll loop in procurement as well.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, IT Operations
EmeraldCare

--

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@emeraldcare.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production walkthrough request — Redwood Inference

Lena — thanks for the clear checklist and the portal link.

We're happy to start the intake today. Quick notes/questions from our side so the review goes smoothly:
- We'll upload a redacted architecture diagram and our standard SOC2-attestation summary. Is a one-page attestation (ISO/SSP pointer + SOC2 report summary) sufficient for your team initially?
- For SSO validation, can we create a temporary test account in your IdP (SAML metadata or OIDC client)? If you prefer, we can run a short screen-share to demonstrate SSO without full provisioning.

We can also sign your NDA — attaching our signed copy for convenience (NDA_EmeraldCare_signed.pdf). If you'd rather have us sign the EmeraldCare template, point me to it and I'll prioritize.

If procurement confirms they need the portal completed before any live demo, would your team be open to a 20–30 minute pre-demo technical brief for our internal engineers (non-production, redacted data) while the portal is processed? That lets us cover integration patterns and removes some scheduling churn.

Proposed alternate slots (in case of processing delay):
- Thu June 15 — 10:00–10:45 PT (technical brief)
- Mon June 19 — 14:00–15:00 PT (full walkthrough, tentative)

Attaching: NDA_EmeraldCare_signed.pdf; redacted-architecture.pdf

Thanks — looping in Rishi & Ben to kick off the intake form and gather attestation artifacts.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

--

From: EmeraldCare Procurement <procurement@emeraldcare.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@emeraldcare.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Jun 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production walkthrough request — Redwood Inference

Hi Ava / Lena,

Quick note from procurement/security intake — we need the following items completed before we approve any production-facing demo or exec briefing that includes environment details:
1) Full vendor portal submission (link: https://vendor-portal.emeraldcare.com/intake/abcd-1234). Please use the attached intake template to speed review.
2) Counter-signed NDA (we have to have the procurement-signed copy on file). If you used your NDA, please upload a counter-signed EmeraldCare form.
3) SSO/IdP metadata or a one-off test account for validation (SAML metadata preferred).
4) A short security attestation document covering encryption at rest, logging/retention, and data residency. A SOC2 attestation or equivalent will expedite review.

Once the portal is submitted our security team schedules the technical review (typically 48–72 business hours). If these items aren't present we can't move the demo to production scope — the team will only approve a redacted high-level briefing.

If you'd like, procurement can fast-track the intake if you email completed materials directly to procurement@emeraldcare.com with the subject: "Vendor Intake — Redwood Inference".

Thanks,
Procurement Team
EmeraldCare

Attachment: EmeraldCare_Vendor_Portal_Template.xlsx

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: EmeraldCare Procurement <procurement@emeraldcare.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@emeraldcare.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 13:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production walkthrough request — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clarity and the template — appreciate the path to fast-track.

Status update: Rishi & Ben have started filling the portal template and we're uploading the redacted architecture and our SOC2 summary today. We've also attached the counter-signed NDA (NDA_EmeraldCare_signed.pdf) to procurement@emeraldcare.com per your instructions.

Given the portal requirement and the 48–72 hour review window, can we tentatively push the full production walkthrough to the week of June 19? If your team is able to expedite after we upload the materials, we can move earlier.

In the meantime, we'd still like to offer a 30-minute technical pre-brief that does not include production credentials or sensitive logs — purely redacted architecture and integration patterns. Proposed slots:
- Tue June 13 — 11:00–11:30 PT
- Wed June 14 — 09:00–09:30 PT

If neither works we'll keep June 19 open for a full session and confirm once the intake is complete.

Attachments: NDA_EmeraldCare_signed.pdf, redacted-architecture.pdf

Best regards,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
